meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装并接线 HyperFrames 的界面构建块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 HyperFrames 搭建应用
copy.tagline_en: Install and wire HyperFrames building blocks into your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你安装、搜索并接入 HyperFrames 的现成块与组件:通过命令行安装单个或按标签安装多个,告诉你文件写入位置和要粘贴的接入代码;也能按意图搜索目录,没有合适结果就上报缺失。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或搜索 HyperFrames 注册表项、把已安装的块接进 index.html,或处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 搜索能逐行展示标题的效果块。
帮我安装所有 captions 标签的块。
say.note: 运行 add,安装所有该标签的块并打印文件位置。

say.text: 把刚装的 grain-overlay 组件接进我主项目。
say.note: 指导粘贴 HTML、CSS 和脚本,完成接线。

howto.what_en: Claude can install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks and components: it installs one item or every block matching a tag, prints file locations and snippets, ranks search results by intent, and reports missing items.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install or search registry items, wire an installed block into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Search for a block that shows a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Runs catalog --query and returns ranked matches.
Runs add for each and prints file locations.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into my main project.
say_en.note: Guides pasting HTML, CSS, and scripts.
